aboutPage.title: Four Decades of Building the Kingdom
aboutPage.description: From a regional contracting firm to a national EPC leader — our story is written in the infrastructure that powers Saudi Arabia's growth.

story.title: Built on Trust, Proven by Delivery
story.body1: Founded in Riyadh, Wjeen International Co., Ltd. grew from a single-project contractor into one of the Kingdom's most trusted EPC groups. Every mandate — from highway interchanges to solar mega-plants — was won on the same principle: deliver what we promise, on schedule, without compromise.
story.body2: Today our teams operate across all 13 administrative regions, backed by a fleet of over 20,000 heavy machinery units and a workforce that has grown Saudization at its core, in step with Vision 2030.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.lead: What we set out to build.
cards.body: To deliver world-class infrastructure, energy, and building projects that strengthen the communities we serve — safely, sustainably, and on time, every time.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.body: To be the Kingdom's most trusted contracting partner, recognized for engineering excellence and our contribution to Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030.

cards.title: Our Purpose
cards.body: Infrastructure outlives the people who build it. Every road, plant, and tower we hand over is meant to serve the Kingdom for decades — so we build for the generation that inherits it, not the deadline in front of us.

cards.title: Our Promise
cards.lead: What we commit to on every site.
cards.body: We quote what we can deliver and we deliver what we quote. No compromise on safety, no shortcuts on quality, and no surprises on schedule — the same standard on a nine-figure package as on the smallest works order.
